hypotheses.N0_native_channels_recompose_final_mlp_p: All 4,608 final-layer channels recompose the final-MLP direct-path behavioral effect to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.N1_shared_512_channel_bank_is_sufficient: A discovery-frozen shared 512-channel bank retains at least 0.90 of prediction, target, and margin path effects on every corpus.
hypotheses.N2_shared_2048_channel_bank_is_sufficien: The shared 2,048-channel bank retains at least 0.90 of all fitted path effects on every corpus.
hypotheses.N3_endpoint_specific_512_banks_are_suffi: Separately selected 512-channel banks retain at least 0.90 for their endpoint on every corpus.
hypotheses.N4_individual_paths_are_native_dense: Median per-context norm-effective support is at least 512 channels for every fitted endpoint and corpus.
hypotheses.N5_native_path_uses_signed_cancellation: Median absolute target-projection mass is at least 2.0 for every fitted endpoint and corpus.
hypotheses.N6_shared_bank_beats_random: At 512 channels, the shared bank exceeds the random-bank p95 by at least 0.10 for every fitted endpoint and corpus.
hypotheses.N7_shared_native_bank_transfers_ood: At 1,024 channels, each OOD endpoint fidelity is within 0.10 of FineWeb.
